sections.content:
Slot→slot also does nothing! M at L1 is highlighted (selected) in the image, but O hasn't moved. So once a piece is in a slot, it can't be moved by clicking? Wait — but in the previous turn I moved pieces between slots… did I really? Let me check the history: in the previous turn, I clicked (36,22) and (36,40) — those are L1 and L4 — and the board changed from L: b,Y,N,M to L: M,Y,N,b. So at that time the slot→slot move did work! What was different?
Previous sequence: MOUSE(36,22), MOUSE(36,40) → L1 and L4 swapped (b↔M). So back then, clicking L1 then L4 swapped them. This time: MOUSE(22,22) then MOUSE(37,22) → nothing happened. Difference: row 22 vs row 36/37? The upper slot is at rows 21-24; I clicked row 22, col 22. The lower is at rows 36-39; I clicked row 37, col 22. Hmm, both should be valid.
Wait, maybe the issue is: after the first MOUSE(22,22), O got selected (highlighted in the image). Then MOUSE(37,22) — in the image M is highlighted… so the second click selected M and deselected O? That is, clicking a slot piece just selects it, and to move a selected piece you have to click an empty slot? But all slots are filled!
Hmm, so how did the previous swap work? Let me re-check: the previous turn's actions: MOUSE(36,22), MOUSE(36,40), MOUSE(57,23), MOUSE(36,22), SPACE. Before that turn, the board was U: O,p,R; L: b,Y,N,M (config B). After: L: M,Y,N,b?? Wait, the output said "U: O,p,R L: M,Y,N,b" — hmm, actually the first action pair (36,22)→(36,40) swapped b and M: L1=b→L4, L4=M→L1. So at that time the slot→slot swap worked.
Difference from now: at that time I clicked (36,22) — row 36. Now I clicked (22,22) — row 22. Maybe the upper slot needs a different row? The upper piece spans rows 21-24; row 22 should be inside. Hmm.
Or: maybe the swap only works when the two slots are in the same box? Previously both were lower (36,22) and (36,40). This time I tried upper (22,22) → lower (37,22) — cross-box. Maybe cross-box moves are forbidden!
Let me test an upper→upper swap: MOUSE(22,22) then MOUSE(22,40) (U1↔U4). If they swap, then moves are only within a box.

sections.label: ASSISTANT
sections.content: Slot→slot across boxes did nothing. Previously, swapping within the same box (L1↔L4) worked. Test upper→upper swap U1↔U4.
